title: Hard plastics and hard-to-see controls
summary: This topic combines several loosely related issues around hard or cheap-feeling interior plastics, controls or menus that are hard to find, and displays or icons that are hard to see, with very limited explicit sentiment labeling.

positive.summary: One positive review says owning the EV makes its benefits easier to appreciate despite the phrase about being hard to see otherwise.

negative.summary: One negative review criticizes controls for being hard to locate and not intuitive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention hard plastics that feel cheap or creaky, icons and screens that are hard to see, menus and options that are hard to find, and a few unrelated uses of the word hard without clear sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments in this topic are labeled undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is sparse.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects including interior material quality, visibility or glare, menu discoverability, app or support difficulty, and a literal reference to a phone case.
Because the examples are stratified samples rather than representative estimates, they should not be used to infer overall prevalence or defect rates.
